law.citation: Undang-Undang Nomor 14, 15 and 16 Tahun 2022 formed the provinces of Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah and Papua Pegunungan from Papua, and Undang-Undang Nomor 29 Tahun 2022 formed Papua Barat Daya from Papua Barat. ISO 3166-2:ID lists the four provinces.

units.citation: Wikidata, the item whose ISO 3166-2 code (P300) is this unit's: Indonesian and English labels, item id and code. The GeoNames id is the unit's row in GeoNames admin1CodesASCII.txt.

membership.citation: Each member is assigned to the province that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26. The assignment agrees with the regencies each statute lists.

units.name: Papua Pegunungan
units.note: Record 1108796893 is titled Asmat and lies in the highlands, where GeoNames files 2 of the 3 populated places inside it under Papua Pegunungan. The Asmat regency of Papua Selatan is record 102073423.

units.name: Papua Barat
units.note: The Manokwari record's boundary predates the province: GeoNames files 33 of the 151 populated places inside it under Papua Barat Daya.
